figurative_meaning_en: friendship with the bottle, implying a drinking companion or alcoholic
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এখন বোতলের বন্ধু হয়ে গেছে, সবসময় মদ খায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He has become a friend of the bottle, always drinking alcohol.
At the party, his drinking buddies were there.
note: This idiom highlights social attitudes towards alcohol consumption in Bengali culture.
